overview: Built an automated customer support and SLA management system for handling support requests across multiple communication channels.

The workflow takes a new customer request and turns it into a structured support ticket, including customer identification, issue classification, priority scoring, knowledge base research, response generation, escalation, SLA tracking, follow ups, and final resolution management.

list: Receives customer support requests from website forms, Gmail, and WhatsApp
Searches CRM records to identify existing customers
Creates new customer records when required
Retrieves previous support tickets and customer history
Cleans and normalizes incoming customer messages
Classifies support requests using AI
Detects issue category, urgency, sentiment, language, and required department
Identifies critical risks such as security issues, outages, legal complaints, and repeated unresolved problems
Calculates a weighted priority score for every support request
Routes tickets based on critical, normal, or low priority levels
Creates structured support tickets automatically in the CRM
Creates dedicated Google Drive folders for ticket attachments
Uploads customer screenshots, PDFs, and supporting documents
Searches the Notion knowledge base for relevant support information
Evaluates whether the available knowledge is sufficient for an automated response
Generates customer responses using AI and available support documentation
Validates responses before sending them to customers
Sends replies through Gmail or WhatsApp based on the original communication channel
Sends uncertain tickets to the support team for human review
Escalates critical support issues immediately through Slack
Assigns tickets to the correct support department or agent
Calculates SLA deadlines according to ticket priority
Monitors open tickets for approaching SLA deadlines
Sends SLA warning notifications to the support team
Sends customer follow ups when responses remain pending
Closes resolved tickets and generates AI resolution summaries
Sends customer satisfaction requests after successful resolution
Updates support analytics and operational records automatically

blocks.p: The workflow uses predefined support, escalation, response, and SLA templates throughout the customer service process.

list: Customer response format
Support communication tone
Escalation rules
SLA priority requirements
Follow up messaging

blocks.p: This keeps support communication consistent while allowing every ticket to be handled according to its issue type, priority, and customer history.
HubSpot or SmartSuite acts as the central customer support database and ticket tracking system.
Each processed ticket is updated with:

list: Customer information
Issue category
Priority score
Support status
SLA deadline
Assigned team
Response history
Resolution summary
Customer satisfaction status

result: A complete automated customer support pipeline that turns a customer request into an identified, classified, prioritized, assigned, tracked, and resolved support ticket without requiring support teams to manually manage every step.
The system also keeps customer history, ticket records, attachments, AI responses, SLA deadlines, escalations, resolution summaries, and support analytics organized in one workflow.
